text: Level three, question six: a train passes two men walking in the same direction as the train, at two and four kilometres per hour, in nine seconds and ten seconds; find the train's length and speed. Question seven: two trains run in the same direction at sixty and forty-two kilometres per hour; a man sitting in the slower train sees the faster train pass him completely in twenty seconds; find the length of the faster train. Question eight: two trains of equal length run in the same direction on parallel tracks at forty-six and thirty-six kilometres per hour; the faster passes the slower completely in thirty-six seconds; find the length of each train.
